title: Papiers de Sophie Germain (BnF, Français 9115, 9117, 9118 et NAF 4073) : transcriptions LaTeX et lectures modernisées
description:
Transcriptions of the four volumes of Sophie Germain's papers held by the Bibliothèque nationale de France and digitised whole in Gallica: Français 9115 (Recueil de dissertations et problèmes mathématiques et physiques, 750 views, ark:/12148/btv1b90724875), Français 9117 (Considérations générales sur l'état des sciences et des lettres, 113 views, ark:/12148/btv1b90075733), Français 9118 (correspondence with Cauchy, Delambre, Fourier, Gauss, Legendre and others, 103 views, ark:/12148/btv1b9007572p) and NAF 4073 (correspondence, 44 views, ark:/12148/btv1b10089787b) — 1,010 Gallica views in all.

For each volume: the transcription in LaTeX, twenty Gallica views to a file, in the spelling, abbreviations and notation of the manuscript, with a critical apparatus in French (what was read, what was guessed, what is illegible, and the folio where the library's foliation can be read); and the modernised reading, in French and current notation, with footnotes carrying every translation of the period's notation. Each \page{N} is a Gallica view number, so every passage can be checked against the facsimile Gallica serves.

Status. These are first passes made by Claude models (Anthropic) under the depositor's direction — each file names in its header the model and the date of its pass — and have not yet been checked against the views by a human. They are published so that they can be cited and corrected.

Rights. The manuscripts are in the public domain. No image is included: the facsimiles are the BnF's and are read in Gallica (« Source gallica.bnf.fr / Bibliothèque nationale de France »). No transcription or edition by anyone else was reproduced or used to seed a reading. The deposit is released under CC0 1.0: a faithful transcription of a public-domain text very probably creates no new right, so on the transcriptions CC0 says only that nothing is claimed; the modernised readings are original texts, and there the waiver has real effect.

Reading interface, with each view beside its transcription: https://germain.commutator.io/xix/ — source repository: https://github.com/Commutator-IO/germain-project
notes: Prepared on 2026-09-23 for issue #7 of Commutator-IO/germain-project; not yet deposited. The files to upload are transcripts/fr-9115, fr-9117, fr-9118 and naf-4073 (batch-NN.fr.tex and <volume>.modern.tex), with transcripts/preamble and, optionally, the PDFs from npm run pdf and the TEI from npm run tei.
